records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Operating revenues increased 3.5% for the three months ended September 30, 2025, compared to the same period of the prior year.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Truckload Logistics revenues (75% of total Werner Logistics segment revenues) increased $19.8 million, or 13%, in third quarter 2025, driven by a 12% increase in shipments.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Industry capacity has continued to contract following recent regulatory and enforcement actions related to non-domiciled commercial driver's licenses (“CDLs”), B1 Visas, and English Language Proficiency standards.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: We had an operating loss of $13.0 million in third quarter 2025 compared to $17.6 million operating income in third quarter 2024, and our operating margin percentage decreased to (1.7)% in third quarter 2025 from 2.4% in third quarter 2024.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: TTS segment had an operating loss of $13.8 million in third quarter 2025 compared to $21.6 million operating income in third quarter 2024, and its operating margin percentage decreased to (2.7)% in third quarter 2025 from 4.1% in third quarter 2024.
